en.title: Tabs
en.description: Switch sibling views inside one page. The component is the tablist; you render the panel.
en.defaultDescription: v-model binds the active value. selected + setSelected is the Hesoyam-shaped alias.
en.secondaryDescription: variant secondary is a compact pill. Use it in dense chrome, not as page-level navigation.
en.disabledDescription: disabled on Tabs locks the whole list. Pointer events drop and opacity falls to 50.
en.disableTabDescription: disabled + tooltip on one item. The tooltip names the constraint, not the tab's purpose.
en.iconsDescription: tabs[].icon is a Vue component or VNode. Build Lucide icons through Icon.
en.badgeDescription: badge is a count chip. Omit it at zero — do not append (12) to the title.
